newsitem.title: USA: Telular gets $10 million in financing.
newsitem.headline: Telular gets $10 million in financing.

text.p: Telular Corp said Monday it has issued 10,000 shares of Series A Convertible Preferred Stock in exchange for about $10 million.
Telular said the funds will be used to develop new products for the worldwide Fixed Wireless Terminal business.

"We believe the market for Wireless Local Loop is experiencing substantial growth and Telular will devote the resources to meet the customer requirements in both analog and digital standards," said Ken Millard, Telular president and chief executive officer, in a statement.

The preferred stock carries a five percent annual stock dividend. The preferred stock automatically converts to Telular common stock on April 16, 1999, or October 16, 1999, depending upon the conversion price.

Prior to maturity, the preferred stock is convertible by the holders or the company under specific terms and conditions. In both cases, the conversion formula is based on the Nasdaq closing bid prices for the company's common stock. The company also has the right to redeem the preferred stock for cash at defined terms.

Telular has developed telecommunications interface technology that switches a standard phone system, fax, computer modem or monitored alarm system to available wireless service for either primary or back-up communications.
The transaction was arranged by Lehman Brothers.
